Randomization detection test (A4 W10): runs 100 shuffles plus 50 GBM synthetic runs against shuffled bars. If a strategy still shows edge on shuffled/GBM data the backtester likely has a lookahead/future-data leak. Hard gate on TESTING->PAPER lifecycle promotion (fail-closed).

B15 Parameter Robustness Battery (Wave 25 Item 5): runs ±20% jitter on each parameter, computes Stability-Dependence Ratio (SDR), Population Stability Index (PSI), and Robustness-Weighted Score (RWS). Hard gate on PAPER->DEPLOY_READY when SDR < 0.85 OR PSI > 0.05 OR RWS > 0.20 (QuantForgeAnalytics 2026-05-16 institutional spec). Advisory-only when B15_BATTERY_ENABLED=false (30-day grandfather period). Required because perturbation-fragility kills strategies that survive WF/CPCV/PBO/DSR.

Empirical signal-correlation check (A7 W11) on PAPER->DEPLOY_READY promotion. Backtester emits per-bar int8 signal vector (1=long, -1=short, 0=none); persistence layer gzip-compresses to bytea in strategy_signal_vectors. Hard gate fails closed when a candidate strategy lacks a signal vector OR has cosine similarity > 0.85 with any DEPLOYED strategy. Closes the Two Sigma 2025 failure mode (different code, identical signals). Defense-in-depth complement to C9 DSL diversity (W17, pre-backtest).

Synthetic Black Swan Survival check (A14 W19) — Phase 0 SHADOW ONLY (Day 0-60). Trains a VAE generator on real OHLCV and produces statistically-realistic novel regimes that didn't happen but plausibly could; tests every PAPER-promotable strategy against thousands of these synthetic regimes before PAPER->DEPLOY_READY. Phase 0 logs WARN + writes audit_log advisory when survival_rate < 0.60; promotion proceeds regardless. Phase 1 (Day 60+, requires explicit env flag flip) becomes a hard gate blocking PAPER->DEPLOY_READY when survival_rate < 0.60. Closes the gap A4 Frankenstein and B10 MRP cannot — fragility to UNSEEN regimes.

Prop-Firm Survival Twin (B14 W20) — Phase 0 ADVISORY ONLY (Day 0-60). Bayesian + Monte Carlo survival probability per (strategy, firm) over a 180-day challenge horizon. Combines per-firm adversarial priors (suspension, VPN detection, payout denial, fund freeze, profitable-trader ban) with strategy modulators (payout-request size HIGH/EXTREME bands, payout-frequency cap, VPN coefficient driven by 1-automation_friendly). READ paths bypass pipelinePauseGate; admin refit endpoint is pause-gated (423). Per-firm error isolation in /rank and /simulate augmentation. Phase 0 surfaces survival probability + 180-day curve + evidence weight on every response and the /prop-firm UI but NEVER affects bestFirm selection or any lifecycle gate. Phase 1 (Day 60+, requires explicit B14_PHASE_1=true env flag flip) becomes a hard gate at PAPER->DEPLOY_READY when survival_probability < 0.50 and a tiebreaker in bestFirm selection. Answers the question B5 ROI ranking cannot — which firm will actually let the operator collect the payout (Apex banned profitable traders May 2025; MFFU froze funds 2023-2025; VPN-denied payouts unresolved 6+ months).

Wave 25 Pass 4 (W25.7) — pure-functional confluence decay/staleness engine. 7 pure decay functions (fvgDecay/obDecay/chochDecay/mssDecay/smtDecay/vpLevelDecay/genericDecay) with named half-lives (FVG 200 bars, OB 150, CHoCH 100, MSS 80, SMT 60, VP 5 sessions, generic 200). deriveFactorDecay() aggregate maps canonical factor names → decay result.
